evidence.claim: Offers a comprehensive portfolio of fire tenders, foam tenders, emergency rescue tenders, crash fire tenders, and rapid intervention vehicles.
Supplies specialized high-reach aerial platforms such as the S70XDT and serves as the authorized partner for Bronto Skylift in India.
Trades individual equipment such as breathing air compressors, chainsaw blades, thermal imaging cameras, and S Gard protective fire suits.
Maintains municipal and industrial firefighting units in active operational field service for aged profiles exceeding 25 years.
Equipment is deployed across high-hazard environments including major airports, ports, refineries, ordnance factories, and the Indian Navy.
Specializes in custom design and engineering of multi-combination large truck firefighting platforms adapted onto local Indian and foreign chassis.
Collaborated with Bronto Skylift to execute the technical milestone of mounting specialized aerial work platforms locally onto an Indian chassis.
Operates specialized heavy equipment manufacturing and assembly facilities located in Mathura, Uttar Pradesh, and Palghar, Maharashtra.
Governs its production operations under a certified ISO 9001:2015 quality management system to enforce consistent output benchmarks.
Designs and manufactures equipment in structural compliance with standard commercial frameworks and international quality guidelines.
Products meet rigid technical requirements established for defense supply, catering directly to the Indian Air Force and Other Indian Defence Establishments.
